alternatives.note: JPEG severity 2, within glass stochastic run variance of winner

analysis.rationale: blur_glass:3 -> compression_jpeg:1. Compression: block_boundary=1.6844 (>1.1, 0% FP) confirms JPEG; PSNR monotonic jpeg 1>2>3>4>5 with glass:3 fixed -> severity 1 (sev2 within glass run variance). Blur: glass_score=0.4594>0.25 and sigma<3 -> glass DT; PSNR arbiter glass sev3 28.41 vs gaussian sev3 24.98 vs motion 18.24; severity scan sev2 25.76 / sev3 28.41 / sev4 27.03 / sev5 24.66. Glass uses random pixel shuffle (nondeterministic), so PSNR<40 is its expected ceiling per SKILL C4, hence UNCERTAIN not POOR. Order: JPEG-first equal PSNR (28.54) but block_boundary 48% error and CI 4/10 vs 9% and 7/10 -> blur then JPEG kept. No noise (noise_prior sigma 0.62 unpeeled / 0.99 peeled < 2; extreme_pct 58% matches known JPEG/blur FP rule at sigma<5). No global (mean_shift=-0.1/255, contrast_spread_ratio=0.953, saturation_chroma_ratio=0.905). Single support k=1: final candidate verified on pair0 only (repeat 28.41 dB, CI 7/10); no cross-pair validation possible.
